record_title: Exact step-size amplification from fused decoupled decay under Stiefel polar retraction
provenance: Exact finite-step analysis of decoupled Euclidean radial decay fused with a tangent update before polar retraction on the Stiefel manifold, motivated by arXiv:2609.19363.
limitations: One-step exact-arithmetic theorem for tangent directions and positive radial factor 1-eta*lambda. It does not analyze optimizer moment evolution, stochastic convergence, generalization, or unprojected ambient AdamW directions. Exact conditioning and chordal formulas are specific to polar retraction. Originality is to the best of our knowledge, with residual risk from recent or poorly indexed work.
